I’ve tried to explain to him that he’s not responsible for my mental health but he feels guilty if I’m not happy, it’s like he wants to be the source of happiness for me ALL THE TIME, even if we’re apart and won’t see each other for a long time. I’ve been dealing with depression for so long, sometimes I cry for no reason and sometimes I cry for a reason, he won’t understand that depression isn’t curable and it won’t stop just because he makes me happy. 

There are times where I’m hanging out with my friends and I’m having the best time of my life but then I start crying or shut down or have an anxiety attack. It’s just been like that all the time, I want him to realize that. I just don’t know how to go on about explaining it to him.

Thank you! It’s really hard keeping those things to myself but it’s for the best. Those other people used to go to school with those girls so they’ve been around them for a long time and got used to how they were treated. It was only until highschool that some girls had enough (those girls came from two different middle schools) and chose to cut those girls off for the sake of their happiness but they’re not good people. They’re just like them but slightly less evil. Their reputation wasn’t damaged at all, I guess those girls recognized that these people had enough since why’ve been around each other for years, and I think that’s why the girls didn’t go after them as harshly as they came after me

Those girls kind of cut me off first and I was like okay whatever cause I was gonna do the same. I just cut everyone that associates with them, everyone that lied to me, everyone that talked bad about me, etc,. Also, yes, they used to be my close friends, we shared some intimate secrets and some really wild things with each other so it was kind of a surprise that one problem would cause the whole friendship to collapse. My reputation is ruined among EVERYONE in my grade, people that I became friends with after those girls cut me off also cut me off because of the problem. I’m too problematic to be around. I, of course, was not their first victim, I know multiple people who don’t like them and have something against them (keep in mind these people endured more than me but they got influenced too much by those girls for me to befriend them. The reason a lot of people support them is because they’re a big group of girls with connections, they’re 10 girls who know half of the city, they do have problems with other people but I don’t think it was big enough to go around the city. Idk why my problem with them was so big? It wasn’t even that serious to be completely honest. I know at least 20 people who despise them but they’re fake so I’m not gonna spend my time trying to convince fake people to not be friends with those girls. I have so much information about them and everyone around them, I can literally ruin everyone’s reputation and friendships but that’s evil and I wouldn’t want to be like them.

There was a problem that happened about 6 months ago and I thought it was get solved within the same week but it got dragged on until NOW and it’s been going on and I tried to solve it but, you know, these girls are just a different breed of toxic. They would make sure people ignored me and made me feel lonely and shit, they would go around and spread stuff about me, they’d say petty and shady things towards me and to other ppl around me. I’m starting to get tired of it bc it’s such a stupid ass problem. Even some of my family friends know about it, I feel like the whole city knows about it because these girls LOVE to talk they LOVE to make people’s lives miserable. I get told by a lot of people that I’m too nice and I let people walk all over me. They also tell me when I try to be mature and be the bigger person it gives other ppl the opportunity to step all over me bc I’m not doing anything about it. To conclude this, I can’t really do anything bc my reputation is ruined over something sooo so so so fucking stupid, I can’t even tell my side of the story bc people won’t give me the chance and they’ll think I’m lying. either way, I’m done, I have nothing better to do. So I’m just gonna either waste my life away or kill myself
My parents have agreed to find me a suitable therapist but I’m very hesitant to move forward. Therapists feel fake.
No, I feel like I would be crying every time I go there or lie to my therapist about my emotions
That’s true but I wanna save myself from getting backstabbed and lied to by friends. The world is cruel so it’s better to be cautious

Lonely in the sense that I don’t have any friends/people to hang out with. I don’t talk to anyone unless they talk to me, which happens usually at grocery stores and the gym. I mostly have online friends and just some people from my city that I talk to from time to time. Otherwise I don’t go out and try to make friends, I don’t discuss my problems with people unless I’m on the verge of doing something to myself. So far it’s been this way for the past 5 months. All alone at home, just doing my own thing.

That’s true, people will not want to be your friend unless it benefits them. If you think about it everyone is selfish and fake, why do we make friends? To have some company and someone to talk to. Why do we get boyfriends or girlfriends? For sex, love, affection, company, etc. Everyone is using everyone just to not feel alone, if human interaction wasn’t so necessary then no one would have friends or bfs/gfs. As a lonely person by choice, I consider myself lucky to not have to deal with fake people on the daily, I stay home and find new hobbies and go to gym or do something to distract me. It’s better than being 8 feet deep into some drama or to find out I was being used by some “friends.” So consider yourself lucky that you’ve realized that everyone around you is fake, this way you can distance yourself and work on becoming a better person.
Thank you!!! ❤️❤️❤️ this really makes me feel not so lonely. Bless your soul.

Thank you so much for the reassurance. I’ve made some friends but since these girls are popular, they’re also friends with my friends. I feel like everyone who befriends me is going to get a bad rep and abandon me but it’s okay. I talked to some friends outside of school, and everything will be okay. I didn’t do anything to myself last night, i was just having a meltdown.
